player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely concluded the task by issuing "DONE" while in the Dining room, failing to realize that the Guest room (which I had just visited) still had an unexplored direction (east) that could lead to new rooms. My strategy of simply following available directions without tracking which specific paths from each room had been exhausted led to this oversight. Next time, I will maintain a mental map of visited rooms and the specific directions taken from them. Before declaring "DONE," I will verify that every room I have entered has had all its available directions explored. If I return to a room like the Guest room, I will explicitly check if I have tried all listed directions (south, east) before moving on or stopping.
